cpp_runtime_differential_tests.scope: Counted reference suites: MSNumpress raw codecs (295), the ProForma parser (476) and writer (160), DateTime (301) and the private massDeltaText_ formatter (1078) against extracted OpenMS translation units, plus 488 predictions against unmodified external LIBSVM. Several probes substitute hand-written stub headers or a capture-only error adapter for SDK infrastructure, so the compiled unit is an adaptation rather than the shipped C++.
cpp_runtime_differential_tests.not_covered: No algorithm with SDK dependency closure -- no smoother, picker, aligner, inference algorithm or feature finder -- has been compared against executed C++. The full C++ SDK was not built. Evidence for those groups is transcribed class-test literals, independently derived expectations and Rust-only invariant tests, which detect transcription drift but not a misread algorithm.
cpp_runtime_differential_tests.harness: No full-SDK differential harness yet. Isolated probe drivers and retained outputs are recorded in per-group manifests; the prebuilt C++ reference remains outside this repository.
cpp_runtime_differential_tests.additional_probes: The FORMAT numeric-overload, SQLite S0 connector, S1 SWATH and S1 short-array Numpress probes are retained separately in their manifests, outside the scientific case totals above. Connector/SWATH contexts use declared adaptations; the short-array probe compiles the exact standalone raw codec. None executes the full SDK.

implemented: Owned DigestionEnzymeRNA records and RNaseDB with source alias/index replacement behavior
All fourteen source RNA enzyme definitions, registered per-code predicates and comma-composed/literal searches

rnase.default_difference: Native default is fully configured RNase_T1; the C++ inherited default leaves RNA-specific gains uninitialized until setEnzyme.
rnase.source_conventions: Raw record-code matching, start-first then missed-cleavage order, original outer termini and source internal-gain rewriting/overwriting; main regex is compiled against the same native subset even though RNA digestion does not use it.
rnase.limit_policy: Public digestion max fields can lower hard ceilings. Work includes tree-key comparison bounds, predicates, planning, validation and copies; output payload is measured by fragment residues plus conservative ends/context. Cut/prefix scratch is additionally bounded by the hard residue ceiling.
rnase.graph_bounds: One atomic transaction; input traversal, parsing, residue/product counts and retained payload share cumulative allowances across every parent. Parsing payload is charged before vector reservation. Graph staging and registration share separate GraphLimits.

implemented: Atomic fixed replacement
Variable variant return and atomic append with exact source subset/alternative order
modifications.candidate_identity: Caller slice order; repeated Arc allocation identities collapse, while separate equal-value allocations and same-code different chemistry remain distinct alternatives and may produce duplicate values.
modifications.source_conventions: First fixed terminal candidate and last fixed matching residue candidate win. Maximum one ignores candidate term specificity and replaces ordinary residues; the general path includes empty terminal slots independently of origin. Empty-sequence behavior is retained.
modifications.limit_policy: Configured output count/logical payload includes existing append entries even on no-op calls; checked weighted-subset preflight precedes combinatorial cloning, and staging preserves atomicity. No output deduplication or truncation.

spectra.source_conventions: Declared nucleoside masses, sulfur linkage corrections and a-B ambiguity behavior are preserved; source single/multiple charge progression and final-only precursor quirks remain distinct.
spectra.shared_formula_budget: Formula-based precursor fallback consumes the same remaining work and byte counters through NASequence::mono_mass_with_budget; consumed counters are retained on success and error.
spectra.metadata_policy: Unrelated destination metadata is retained in place. Peak/array staging, shape/value checks and explicit unsupported-array errors prevent partial append or silent annotation loss.

external_reference_note: Executed C++ oracle artifacts of early-TOPP bundle wave 1, registered at integration on 2026-09-14. They live outside this repository under ../oracle/, so no C++ enters it; each sha256 was recomputed from the file at registration, and each origin_key names the in-repo group manifest that records the oracle's full artifact list. A1-PTE-FAIMS (../oracle/pte-faims-helper), CLI-1 (../oracle/topp-cli-lifecycle) and A2-TEXTFMT (../oracle/file-info-text-format and ../oracle/text-format) were registered at the final wave-1 merge, after their fix rounds had changed those files. The A2 group manifest tests/data/file_info_text_format_provenance.json is indexed only through origin_key: its fixtures are constants embedded in tests/file_info_text_format.rs, not files, and its target_verification has no source_revisions or source_changes, so it lacks the current_sdk_reference_manifests shape that tools/check_core_sdk.py verifies. C1 (../oracle/topp-early-bundle) and C2 (../oracle/featurefinder-picked) are registered at W4.4.
